name: Program Design & Intermediate Programming
summary: Moving from scripts to well-designed programs: specifications, recursion, higher-order functions, data abstraction, testing and systematic debugging.

topics.name: Designing functions from specifications: contracts, examples and tests
Recursion and recursive data such as lists and trees
Data abstraction and abstract data types
Classes and objects as a design tool
Unit testing with a test framework (pytest)
Comparing running times of alternative solutions
Working with data: CSV, JSON and web APIs
